ValidationRule.description:
Can not update Deal Review(Accepted) field value once Opportunity is Won
#21199 #24480 -Making Applicable for all record type
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED( Deal_Review_Accepted__c ), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '7 - Closed')), NOT( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(StageName), '4 - Negotiate') ),
$Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin',
NOT( $Permission.Edit_Deal_Review_Accepted_in_Stage_5_6_7 ), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Deal Review (Accepted) cannot be updated in Stage 5/6/7. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
